description: 2020-2023-number-of-ports-by-emirate is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministry of Energy & Infrastructure. The data set represents the number of ports by emirate in the United Arab Emirates. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal shows 28 records. The portal shows 2024-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
